fields.text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: No man hath seen God at any time, the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?

metadata.editionTitle: King James Version — Project Gutenberg eBook 10 text

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And the earth was waste and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep: and the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God called the firmament Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God said, Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God said, Let the earth put forth grass, herbs yielding seed, and fruit-trees bearing fruit after their kind, wherein is the seed thereof, upon the earth: and it was so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And the earth brought forth grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, wherein is the seed thereof, after their kind: and God saw that it was good.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years:

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and let them be for lights in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God made the two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God set them in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God said, Let the waters swarm with swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God created the great sea-monsters, and every living creature that moveth, wherewith the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind: and God saw that it was good.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God said, Let the earth bring forth living creatures after their kind, cattle, and creeping things, and beasts of the earth after their kind: and it was so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God made the beasts of the earth after their kind, and the cattle after their kind, and everything that creepeth upon the ground after its kind: and God saw that it was good.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God blessed them: and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for food:

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and to every beast of the earth, and to every bird of the heavens, and to everything that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for food: and it was so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside still waters.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He restoreth my soul: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou hast anointed my head with oil; My cup runneth over.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of Jehovah for ever.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboreth?

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I have seen the travail which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised therewith.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He hath made everything beautiful in its time: also he hath set eternity in their heart, yet so that man cannot find out the work that God hath done from the beginning even to the end.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I know that there is nothing better for them, than to rejoice, and to do good so long as they live.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor anything taken from it; and God hath done it, that men should fear before him.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: That which is hath been long ago; and that which is to be hath long ago been: and God seeketh again that which is passed away.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I said in my heart, God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I said in my heart, It is because of the sons of men, that God may prove them, and that they may see that they themselves are but as beasts.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; and man hath no preeminence above the beasts: for all is vanity.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Who knoweth the spirit of man, whether it goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast, whether it goeth downward to the earth?

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Wherefore I saw that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him back to see what shall be after him?

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The same was in the beginning with God.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: All things were made through him; and without him was not anything made that hath been made.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And the light shineth in the darkness; and the darkness apprehended it not.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The same came for witness, that he might bear witness of the light, that all might believe through him.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He was not the light, but came that he might bear witness of the light.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: There was the true light, even the light which lighteth every man, coming into the world.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world knew him not.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He came unto his own, and they that were his own received him not.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: But as many as received him, to them gave he the right to become children of God, even to them that believe on his name:

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And the Word became flesh, and dwelt among us (and we beheld his glory, glory as of the only begotten from the Father), full of grace and truth.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: John beareth witness of him, and crieth, saying, This was he of whom I said, He that cometh after me is become before me: for he was before me.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: For of his fulness we all received, and grace for grace.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And this is the witness of John, when the Jews sent unto him from Jerusalem priests and Levites to ask him, Who art thou?

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And he confessed, and denied not; and he confessed, I am not the Christ.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elijah? And he saith, I am not. Art thou the prophet? And he answered, No.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: They said therefore unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said Isaiah the prophet.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And they had been sent from the Pharisees.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why then baptizest thou, if thou art not the Christ, neither Elijah, neither the prophet?

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: John answered them, saying, I baptize in water: in the midst of you standeth one whom ye know not,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: even he that cometh after me, the latchet of whose shoe I am not worthy to unloose.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: On the morrow he seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold, the Lamb of God, that taketh away the sin of the world!

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man who is become before me: for he was before me.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And I knew him not; but that he should be made manifest to Israel, for this cause came I baptizing in water.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And John bare witness, saying, I have beheld the Spirit descending as a dove out of heaven; and it abode upon him.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize in water, he said unto me, Upon whomsoever thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and abiding upon him, the same is he that baptizeth in the Holy Spirit.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And I have seen, and have borne witness that this is the Son of God.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Again on the morrow John was standing, and two of his disciples;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and he looked upon Jesus as he walked, and saith, Behold, the Lamb of God!

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And Jesus turned, and beheld them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? And they said unto him, Rabbi (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), where abidest thou?

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He saith unto them, Come, and ye shall see. They came therefore and saw where he abode; and they abode with him that day: it was about the tenth hour.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: One of the two that heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He findeth first his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messiah (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He brought him unto Jesus. Jesus looked upon him, and said, Thou art Simon the son of John: thou shalt be called Cephas (which is by interpretation, Peter).

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: On the morrow he was minded to go forth into Galilee, and he findeth Philip: and Jesus saith unto him, Follow me.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And Nathanael said unto him, Can any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Nathanael answered him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art King of Israel.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee underneath the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye shall see the heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The same was in the beginning with God.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: In the beginning of God's preparing the heavens and the earth —

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: the earth hath existed waste and void, and darkness [is] on the face of the deep, and the Spirit of God fluttering on the face of the waters,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and God saith, 'Let light be;' and light is.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God seeth the light that [it is] good, and God separateth between the light and the darkness,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and God calleth to the light 'Day,' and to the darkness He hath called 'Night;' and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day one.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God saith, 'Let an expanse be in the midst of the waters, and let it be separating between waters and waters.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God maketh the expanse, and it separateth between the waters which [are] under the expanse, and the waters which [are] above the expanse: and it is so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God calleth to the expanse 'Heavens;' and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day second.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God saith, 'Let the waters under the heavens be collected unto one place, and let the dry land be seen:' and it is so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God calleth to the dry land 'Earth,' and to the collection of the waters He hath called 'Seas;' and God seeth that [it is] good.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God saith, 'Let the earth yield tender grass, herb sowing seed, fruit-tree (whose seed [is] in itself) making fruit after its kind, on the earth:' and it is so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And the earth bringeth forth tender grass, herb sowing seed after its kind, and tree making fruit (whose seed [is] in itself) after its kind; and God seeth that [it is] good;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day third.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God saith, 'Let luminaries be in the expanse of the heavens, to make a separation between the day and the night, then they have been for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and they have been for luminaries in the expanse of the heavens to give light upon the earth:' and it is so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God maketh the two great luminaries, the great luminary for the rule of the day, and the small luminary — and the stars — for the rule of the night;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and God giveth them in the expanse of the heavens to give light upon the earth,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and to rule over day and over night, and to make a separation between the light and the darkness; and God seeth that [it is] good;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day fourth.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God saith, 'Let the waters teem with the teeming living creature, and fowl let fly on the earth on the face of the expanse of the heavens.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God prepareth the great monsters, and every living creature that is creeping, which the waters have teemed with, after their kind, and every fowl with wing, after its kind, and God seeth that [it is] good.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God blesseth them, saying, 'Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and the fowl let multiply in the earth:'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day fifth.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God saith, 'Let the earth bring forth the living creature after its kind, cattle and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after its kind:' and it is so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God maketh the beast of the earth after its kind, and the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, and God seeth that [it is] good.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God saith, 'Let Us make man in Our image, according to Our likeness, and let them rule over fish of the sea, and over fowl of the heavens, and over cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that is creeping on the earth.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God prepareth the man in His image; in the image of God He prepared him, a male and a female He prepared them.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God blesseth them, and God saith to them, 'Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the earth, and subdue it, and rule over fish of the sea, and over fowl of the heavens, and over every living thing that is creeping upon the earth.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God saith, 'Lo, I have given to you every herb sowing seed, which [is] upon the face of all the earth, and every tree in which [is] the fruit of a tree sowing seed, to you it is for food;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the heavens, and to every creeping thing on the earth, in which [is] breath of life, every green herb [is] for food:' and it is so.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And God seeth all that He hath done, and lo, very good; and there is an evening, and there is a morning — day the sixth.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A Psalm of David. Jehovah [is] my shepherd, I do not lack,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: In pastures of tender grass He causeth me to lie down, By quiet waters He doth lead me.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: My soul He refresheth, He leadeth me in paths of righteousness, For His name's sake,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Also — when I walk in a valley of death-shade, I fear no evil, for Thou [art] with me, Thy rod and Thy staff — they comfort me.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Thou arrangest before me a table, Over-against my adversaries, Thou hast anointed with oil my head, My cup is full!

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Only — goodness and kindness pursue me, All the days of my life, And my dwelling [is] in the house of Jehovah, For a length of days!

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: To everything — a season, and a time to every delight under the heavens:

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to bring forth, And a time to die. A time to plant, And a time to eradicate the planted.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to slay, And a time to heal, A time to break down, And a time to build up.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to weep, And a time to laugh. A time to mourn, And a time to skip.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to cast away stones, And a time to heap up stones. A time to embrace, And a time to be far from embracing.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to seek, And a time to destroy. A time to keep, And a time to cast away.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to rend, And a time to sew. A time to be silent, And a time to speak.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: A time to love, And a time to hate. A time of war, And a time of peace.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: What advantage hath the doer in that which he is labouring at?

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I have seen the travail that God hath given to the sons of man to be humbled by it.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The whole He hath made beautiful in its season; also, that knowledge He hath put in their heart without which man findeth not out the work that God hath done from the beginning even unto the end.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I have known that there is no good for them except to rejoice and to do good during their life,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: yea, even every man who eateth and hath drunk and seen good by all his labour, it [is] a gift of God.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I have known that all that God doth is to the age, to it nothing is to be added, and from it nothing is to be withdrawn; and God hath wrought that they do fear before Him.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: What is that which hath been? already it is, and that which [is] to be hath already been, and God requireth that which is pursued.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And again, I have seen under the sun the place of judgment — there [is] the wicked; and the place of righteousness — there [is] the wicked.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I said in my heart, 'The righteous and the wicked doth God judge, for a time [is] to every matter and for every work there.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: I said in my heart concerning the matter of the sons of man that God might cleanse them, so as to see that they themselves [are] beasts.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: For an event [is to] the sons of man, and an event [is to] the beasts, even one event [is] to them; as the death of this, so [is] the death of that; and one spirit [is] to all, and the advantage of man above the beast is nothing, for the whole [is] vanity.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: The whole are going unto one place, the whole have been from the dust, and the whole are turning back unto the dust.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Who knoweth the spirit of the sons of man that is going up on high, and the spirit of the beast that is going down below to the earth?

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And I have seen that there is nothing better than that man rejoice in his works, for it [is] his portion; for who doth bring him in to look on that which is after him?

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: this one was in the beginning with God;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: all things through him did happen, and without him happened not even one thing that hath happened.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: In him was life, and the life was the light of men,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and the light in the darkness did shine, and the darkness did not perceive it.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: There came a man — having been sent from God — whose name [is] John,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: this one came for testimony, that he might testify about the Light, that all might believe through him;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: that one was not the Light, but — that he might testify about the Light.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He was the true Light, which doth enlighten every man, coming to the world;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: in the world he was, and the world through him was made, and the world did not know him:

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: to his own things he came, and his own people did not receive him;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: but as many as did receive him to them he gave authority to become sons of God — to those believing in his name,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: who — not of blood nor of a will of flesh, nor of a will of man but — of God were begotten.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And the Word became flesh, and did tabernacle among us, and we beheld his glory, glory as of an only begotten of a father, full of grace and truth.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: John doth testify concerning him, and hath cried, saying, 'This was he of whom I said, He who after me is coming, hath come before me, for he was before me;'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and out of his fulness did we all receive, and grace over-against grace;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: for the law through Moses was given, the grace and the truth through Jesus Christ did come;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: God no one hath ever seen; the only begotten Son, who is on the bosom of the Father — he did declare.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And this is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent out of Jerusalem priests and Levites, that they might question him, 'Who art thou?'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and he confessed and did not deny, and confessed — 'I am not the Christ.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And they questioned him, 'What then? Elijah art thou?' and he saith, 'I am not.' — 'The prophet art thou?' and he answered, 'No.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: They said then to him, 'Who art thou, that we may give an answer to those sending us? what dost thou say concerning thyself?'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He said, 'I [am] a voice of one crying in the wilderness: Make straight the way of the Lord, as said Isaiah the prophet.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And those sent were of the Pharisees,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and they questioned him and said to him, 'Why, then, dost thou baptize, if thou art not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: John answered them, saying, 'I baptize with water, but in midst of you he hath stood whom ye have not known, this one it is who is coming after me, who hath been before me,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: of whom I am not worthy that I may loose the cord of his sandal.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: These things came to pass in Bethabara, beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: on the morrow John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, 'Lo, the Lamb of God, who is taking away the sin of the world;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: this is he concerning whom I said, After me doth come a man, who hath come before me, because he was before me:

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and I knew him not, but, that he might be manifested to Israel, because of this I came with the water baptizing.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And John testified, saying — 'I have seen the Spirit coming down, as a dove, out of heaven, and it remained on him;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and I did not know him, but he who sent me to baptize with water, He said to me, On whomsoever thou mayest see the Spirit coming down, and remaining on him, this is he who is baptizing with the Holy Spirit;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and I have seen, and have testified, that this is the Son of God.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: On the morrow, again, John was standing, and two of his disciples,

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and having looked on Jesus walking, he saith, 'Lo, the Lamb of God;'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and the two disciples heard him speaking, and they followed Jesus.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And Jesus having turned, and having beheld them following, saith to them, 'What seek ye?' and they said to them, 'Rabbi, (which is, being interpreted, Teacher,) where remainest thou?'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: He saith to them, 'Come and see;' they came, and saw where he doth remain, and with him they remained that day and the hour was about the tenth.

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the two who heard from John, and followed him;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: this one doth first find his own brother Simon, and saith to him, 'We have found the Messiah,' (which is, being interpreted, The Anointed,)

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and he brought him unto Jesus: and having looked upon him, Jesus saith, 'Thou art Simon, the son of Jonas, thou shalt be called Cephas,' (which is interpreted, A rock.)

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: On the morrow, he willed to go forth to Galilee, and he findeth Philip, and saith to him, 'Be following me.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: And Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter;

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith to him, 'Him of whom Moses wrote in the Law, and the prophets, we have found, Jesus the son of Joseph, who [is] from Nazareth;'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and Nathanael said to him, 'Out of Nazareth is any good thing able to be?' Philip said to him, 'Come and see.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming unto him, and he saith concerning him, 'Lo, truly an Israelite, in whom guile is not;'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Nathanael saith to him, 'Whence me dost thou know?' Jesus answered and said to him, 'Before Philip's calling thee — thou being under the fig-tree — I saw thee.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Nathanael answered and saith to him, 'Rabbi, thou art the Son of God, thou art the king of Israel.'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: Jesus answered and said to him, 'Because I said to thee, I saw thee under the fig-tree, thou dost believe; greater things than these thou shalt see;'

fields.name: exactText
fields.text: and he saith to him, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, henceforth ye shall see the heaven opened, and the messengers of God going up and coming down upon the Son of Man.'
